001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007@HistoryLogProps(
008    opCode = 313,
009    displayName = "Daily Status",
010    internalName = "LID_AA_DAILY_STATUS"
011)
012public class DailyStatusHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
013
014    private int sensorType;
015    private int userMode;
016    private int pumpControlState;
017
018    public DailyStatusHistoryLog() {}
019    public DailyStatusHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int sensorType, int userMode, int pumpControlState) {
020        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
021        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, sensorType, userMode, pumpControlState);
022        this.sensorType = sensorType;
023        this.userMode = userMode;
024        this.pumpControlState = pumpControlState;
025
026    }
027
028    public DailyStatusHistoryLog(int sensorType, int userMode, int pumpControlState) {
029        this(0, 0, sensorType, userMode, pumpControlState);
030    }
031
032    public int typeId() {
033        return 313;
034    }
035
036    /**
037     * <table border="1">
038     * <caption>Parsed fields for DailyStatusHistoryLog:</caption>
039     * <tr><td><code>sensorType</code></td><td><code>raw[11]</code></td></tr>
040     * <tr><td><code>userMode</code></td><td><code>raw[12]</code></td></tr>
041     * <tr><td><code>pumpControlState</code></td><td><code>raw[13]</code></td></tr>
042     * </table>
043     */
044    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
045        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
046        this.cargo = raw;
047        parseBase(raw);
048        this.sensorType = raw[11];
049        this.userMode = raw[12];
050        this.pumpControlState = raw[13];
051
052    }
053
054    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int sensorType, int userMode, int pumpControlState) {
055        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
056            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(313, 0),
057            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
058            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
059            new byte[]{0, (byte) sensorType, (byte) userMode, (byte) pumpControlState}));
060    }
061
062    public int getSensorType() {
063        return sensorType;
064    }
065
066    public int getUserMode() {
067        return userMode;
068    }
069
070    public int getPumpControlState() {
071        return pumpControlState;
072    }
073
074    public SensorType getSensorTypeEnum() {
075        return SensorType.fromId(sensorType);
076    }
077
078    public UserMode getUserModeEnum() {
079        return UserMode.fromId(userMode);
080    }
081
082    public PumpControlState getPumpControlStateEnum() {
083        return PumpControlState.fromId(pumpControlState);
084    }
085
086    public enum SensorType {
087        CGM_TYPE_NONE(0),
088        CGM_TYPE_DEXCOM_G6(1),
089        CGM_TYPE_LIBRE2(2),
090        CGM_TYPE_DEXCOM_G7(3),
091
092        ;
093        private final int id;
094        SensorType(int id) {
095            this.id = id;
096        }
097
098        static SensorType fromId(int id) {
099            for (SensorType t : values()) {
100                if (t.id == id) {
101                    return t;
102                }
103            }
104            return null;
105        }
106    }
107
108    public enum UserMode {
109        NORMAL(0),
110        SLEEPING(1),
111        EXERCISING(2),
112
113        ;
114        private final int id;
115        UserMode(int id) {
116            this.id = id;
117        }
118
119        static UserMode fromId(int id) {
120            for (UserMode m : values()) {
121                if (m.id == id) {
122                    return m;
123                }
124            }
125            return null;
126        }
127    }
128
129    public enum PumpControlState {
130        PCM_NO_CONTROL(0),  // No cartridge installed
131        PCM_OPEN_LOOP(1),
132        PCM_PINING(2),
133        PCM_CLOSED_LOOP(3),
134
135        ;
136        private final int id;
137        PumpControlState(int id) {
138            this.id = id;
139        }
140
141        static PumpControlState fromId(int id) {
142            for (PumpControlState s : values()) {
143                if (s.id == id) {
144                    return s;
145                }
146            }
147            return null;
148        }
149    }
150
151}
